studio.title: The Studio
studio.lead: We're an independent studio. We build the apps we need ourselves — and we love making new ones for smart, everyday uses.

sections.h: Made by Mac lovers, for Mac lovers
sections.p: We're a small team of passionate makers who live on our Macs and iPhones all day. Every app starts as an itch we wanted to scratch ourselves: a tool missing from our own workflow, built the way we'd actually want to use it.
We don't chase trends or feature checklists. Each app solves one real problem we personally have, then gets out of the way. If it isn't something we'd reach for every day, we don't ship it.

Our apps are built with the platform, not against it — light, fast, and right at home on your Mac or iPhone. They process your data on your device, with no tracking and no profiling. Your stuff stays yours.
We're self-funded and answer only to the people who use our apps. Buy a license and you're supporting a small studio directly — no investors, no ads, just software made with care.
We read every message. Have an idea, a bug, or just want to say hi? Reach us through our ⟨Support & ideas⟩ page.

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.lead: We believe health shouldn't come with a price tag — especially women's health.

sections.p: Access to basic health tools — tracking your body, understanding your cycle, staying informed — shouldn't depend on your ability to pay. This is especially true for women's health, an area too often treated as a subscription opportunity rather than a basic need.

When we build a health app, its core experience is free — not a stripped-down trial designed to nudge you toward a subscription. We'd rather build something genuinely useful for everyone than something profitable for a few.

Crazy Bee Labs stays afloat through our productivity and utility apps — the tools that help you get things done on your Mac and iPhone. Health apps aren't there to make money; the rest of our lineup is.
If we ever considered locking something essential behind a paywall in a health app, we'd rather not ship it at all. Questions or feedback? Reach us through our ⟨Support & ideas⟩ page.

globalFaq.q: Are Crazy Bee Labs macOS apps free to try?
globalFaq.a: Yes! Every macOS app comes with a free 7-day trial with full features. After the trial, you'll need a paid license to keep using it.

globalFaq.q: How does licensing work for the macOS apps?
globalFaq.a: You download the app from our website, create an account (email and password), and start your 7-day trial. When it ends, you activate a license tied to your account to continue.

globalFaq.q: What license plans do you offer?
globalFaq.a: For macOS apps you can choose monthly, quarterly, or annual subscriptions, or a one-time lifetime license if you'd rather pay once and own it forever.

globalFaq.q: Who is Paddle and why do they handle my payment?
globalFaq.a: Paddle is our Merchant of Record, meaning they securely process your payment and take care of VAT and taxes worldwide. Your receipt will show Paddle as the seller.
Yes. Refunds are handled by Paddle, our payment partner. Just email us at support@crazybeelabs.com and we'll help you sort it out.

globalFaq.q: Which macOS and iOS versions are supported?
globalFaq.a: Our macOS apps target recent versions of macOS, and our iPhone apps support recent versions of iOS. Check each app's page for its exact minimum requirement.

globalFaq.q: How do you handle my privacy and data?
globalFaq.a: We're privacy-first: our apps process your data on your device. We don't harvest or sell your personal information.

globalFaq.q: How do I get app updates?
globalFaq.a: macOS apps update automatically through Sparkle, so you always get the latest version. iPhone apps update through the App Store as usual.
For macOS apps, yes: an account (email and password) ties your license to you and is created when you download or first launch the app. iPhone apps from the App Store don't need one.
Just email us at support@crazybeelabs.com. We're a small independent studio and happy to help.

macnap-blocker.q: Is there a keyboard shortcut to toggle it?
macnap-blocker.a: Yes, there's a global shortcut so you can flip anti-sleep on or off instantly without opening the menu.

macnap-blocker.q: How does it keep the Mac awake?
macnap-blocker.a: It uses macOS's built-in power assertion to prevent idle display sleep, so it's a clean, system-friendly way to stay awake.
Yes, enjoy a free 7-day trial, then choose a monthly, quarterly, annual, or lifetime license to keep it.

sections.p: This Privacy Policy explains how Crazy Bee Labs ("we", "us") handles personal data when you use our website, download our software, or contact our support. Crazy Bee Labs is an independent EU-based software studio. The data controller is [Legal entity name], [Registered address], reachable at support@crazybeelabs.com. For any privacy question you may contact us at that address. We do not have a statutory Data Protection Officer, but privacy requests are handled directly by our team.

Our macOS and iPhone apps are built to process your content on your device. The data you create or open inside an app generally stays on your device and is not sent to us. Our website only collects the limited information needed to run accounts, deliver downloads, manage licenses, process payments, and provide support. We do not sell your personal data and we do not use it for advertising profiling.

Account data: your email address and a hashed password, so we can create and secure your account. Download data: an email address captured when you download an app, so we can deliver it and manage your trial. Licensing data: which product and plan a license covers, its status, and the device activation state, so licenses work correctly. Support data: the content of messages you send us and related contact details. Newsletter data: your email address, only if you choose to subscribe. Technical data: basic server logs (such as IP address, browser type, and timestamps) needed for security and reliability.

We rely on the following GDPR legal bases. Performance of a contract, to provide your account, downloads, licenses, and updates. Legitimate interests, to secure our site, prevent abuse, and answer support requests. Consent, for the optional newsletter, which you can withdraw at any time. Legal obligation, where we must retain certain records, for example tax and accounting records related to your purchases.

Purchases are handled by Paddle, which acts as the Merchant of Record and reseller and is the seller of record for your order. This means Paddle processes your payment and manages billing and applicable VAT or sales tax. When you buy a license, Paddle collects and processes your payment and billing information under its own privacy policy as an independent controller. We receive confirmation of the purchase and the associated license, but we do not receive or store your full card details.

We share personal data only with service providers that help us operate, and only as needed. These include Paddle (payments and billing), our website and database hosting provider [Hosting / database provider, e.g. Neon], and our email delivery provider [Email provider]. These providers act as processors on our behalf, except Paddle which acts as an independent controller for payment processing. Where data is transferred outside the EU or EEA, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses.

We keep account and license data for as long as your account is active and as needed to provide the service. Support messages are kept for a reasonable period to handle follow-up and improve support. apps.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Use — Apps

sections.p: This page is the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use for every Crazy Bee Labs application: Shotbox, Macnap Blocker, Energy Manager, FastRename, SpaceOnMyDisk, Sunshine, Never Miss a Meeting, TopDeck, SpacesPilot, CornerCraft, Deskmate and 1space1wallpaper (macOS), and QualiScan, Period tracker made easy, MenuIsland, DualCam OxO, Quit smoking made easy, Pillo tracker and Video One Sec (iPhone). One page covers the whole family so it stays accurate as new apps ship. The data controller is Crazy Bee Labs, reachable at data@crazybeelabs.com.

Our apps are built to do their real work — scanning, renaming, tracking, reminding, capturing — entirely on your device. The content you create or process inside an app (your screenshots, files, health data, photos, scans, calendar view, wallpapers) is not uploaded to our servers, and we do not read it, sell it, or use it for advertising.

If an app requires a license (our macOS apps), it shares an account with crazybeelabs.com: your email, a hashed password, and optionally a first name, last name and date of birth, plus your license and trial status. This account data is used only to run your trial, validate your license, and provide support — never for tracking or profiling. iPhone apps distributed on the App Store do not require a Crazy Bee Labs account.

A few apps talk to something beyond your device, always for a feature you explicitly use: Never Miss a Meeting reads your Google Calendar with read-only access to schedule its reminders; Cycles syncs through your own private iCloud account, never through our servers; Sunshine requests current weather from Open-Meteo using your coordinates, with no account or personal data attached; Deskmate's chat runs entirely on-device via Apple Intelligence, with no server involved at all. Our macOS apps also check for updates (via Sparkle) and validate your license, both of which contact our servers with minimal technical data (app version, license key) — never your files or content.

Apps only request the system permissions they need to function — for example camera and photo library access (DualCam OxO, QualiScan), calendar access (Never Miss a Meeting), microphone and speech recognition (Deskmate), or accessibility access to move windows (SpacesPilot). You can review and revoke any permission at any time in System Settings or the Settings app.

You can delete your account, license history and any data we hold about you at any time — from your account page at crazybeelabs.com/account (Danger zone → Delete my account), or by emailing data@crazybeelabs.com. Deletion is permanent and removes your downloads, licenses, subscriptions and invoices from our systems. Content that lives only on your device (like your local files, health data, or photos) is yours to delete directly from the app or your device at any time.

We keep account and license data for as long as your account is active. Support messages are kept long enough to handle follow-up. Purchase records are kept as required by tax law. Once you delete your account, the data above is removed except where we are legally required to retain it (such as invoicing records).

Under the GDPR and similar laws, you have the right to access, correct, export or delete your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. Email data@crazybeelabs.com for any request; we may need to verify your identity first. You can also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

Our apps are not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact data@crazybeelabs.com and we will delete it.

Where an app requires a paid license, we grant you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to install and use it under your chosen plan. You may not resell, redistribute or share your license, or attempt to circumvent trial or licensing limits. Free trials run for 7 days from installation. iPhone apps are additionally governed by Apple's App Store terms.

Our apps are provided "as is", to the extent permitted by law. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from their use, and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the relevant license in the past twelve months. Nothing here limits rights that cannot be limited under applicable consumer law.

We may update this page from time to time; the date above reflects the latest revision. For privacy or data questions, write to data@crazybeelabs.com. For general support, use support@crazybeelabs.com or the Support & ideas page on our website.
